description:
"You're familiar with this pose. You used to cover me up so often during the day."
This is the story of Yeon-hwa, who had developed a fundamental aversion to others because of her abilities, meeting Shin-hyeok, opening her heart, reflecting on herself, regaining her self-esteem, and realizing true love.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64805774), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EB%B6%80%ED%84%B0-%ED%95%98%EC%A3%A0/4187), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/4327007113), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/marryy), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/marry_first), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077930), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14073027), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260314)
